course_name_original: Modelling and Simulation of Mechatronic Systems
course_name_en: Modelling and Simulation of Mechatronic Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Obtain knowledge from the modelling of basic dynamic systems and creation of simulation models of mechatronic systems.
Be able to realize the simulation model in the simulation programme and to simulate the responses of the systems.
Be able to use the basic methods of mathematical physical modelling, realization and use of the simulation models in Mechatronics.

syllabus_topics: Modelling, mathematical and simulation models, physical models, their application.
Basic forms of the mathematical models of the dynamic systems, methods of their obtaining, introduction of the analytical and experimental system identification.
Realization of the mathematical model in the simulation programme. Models in form of transfer function, differential equation, nonlinearities, logical functions.

Simulation programmes 
 classification, use and implemented numerical methods.
Modelling of the mechanical subsystems of the mechatronic systems.

Modelling of the vehicle subsystem 
 suspension, breaks and ABS modelling.
Modelling of the electrical subsystems of the mechatronic systems.
Modelling of the hydraulic systems, derivation and realization of the mathematical models.
Modelling of the control systems, digital controllers. Dynamic system analysis using the simulation models.
Step response identification and modelling. Bode plot.
Closed loop control design using the simulation models and simulation programmes.
Verification of the simulation models with the measurement on the real system.

Case study 
 development of the mechatronic system using the computer simulation.
